label: Gaia/Gaia DR3 Epoch Photometry
name: Gaia DR3 Epoch Photometry
description: The Gaia DR3 Epoch Photometry catalog contains the individual photometric measurements (light curves) in the G, BP, and RP bands for a selected subset of approximately 11.7 million sources. While the main Gaia catalog provides time-averaged values, this dataset includes the time-series data used for variability analysis, covering variable stars, transients, and quasars. The version of the catalog presented here packs all time-domain data into the 'epoch_photometry' column.
